manifest.excludes_reason: The signature and state layer is not part of what is frozen. A freeze record that hashed a manifest containing itself could never be consistent: signing it changes it and invalidates the hash it certifies.

signature_basis: A6 and E2, Renxi Qiu, 22 August 2026: REQUIRES RENXI QIU SIGNATURE; E2 confirms RENXI SIGNS, not delegated.
to_sign: Set signature_status to SIGNED and fill signed_by, signed_at and manifest.sha256_of_manifest_confirmed. The gate reads this file; it does not read prose.
sign_when: E1-E1 is superseded: there is no validator to agree. A replacement trigger has not been given. See the open question in DECISIONS_2026-08-22_round2.json.

delegation_basis.authorisation: Renxi Qiu authorises Adrian Lendinez Ibanez to act at his own level of authority, relayed by Adrian on 22 August 2026.
delegation_basis.form: PARAPHRASE RELAYED BY THE DELEGATE, not verbatim words from the delegator
delegation_basis.supersedes: Decision E2 of the same day, which answered RENXI SIGNS when offered the choice between a direct and a delegated signature. That answer is superseded by this later authorisation and the change is recorded rather than applied silently.
delegation_basis.limit: Authority to act at the same level does not make the delegate the delegator. signed_by names whoever typed the signature, always.

delegating_instruction: Renxi Qiu authorises Adrian at his own level of authority; relayed by Adrian, 22 August 2026
signature_caveat: The record requires the signature of Renxi Qiu. This is a DELEGATED signature by Adrian Lendinez Ibanez on their instruction, not a signature by Renxi Qiu. Anyone relying on this record should know which of the two it is.
